steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish basic identifiers including application name and package namespace com.cctvrecordbook.app.

steps.title: Define Database and Calculation Schema
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json with online collections, field descriptors, and balance calculation logic specifications.

steps.title: Establish Android Manifest
steps.description: Set up application structural configurations, declare activities, and request internet access rights with standard material light theme.

steps.title: Configure Android SDK Compilation Settings
steps.description: Establish target SDK 34 compatibility, namespace configurations, and standard Java 8 settings without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Define UI Application Colors and Styles
steps.description: Configure color scheme with customized material themes to ensure standard material lightweight appearance.

steps.title: Create Layout Background Assets
steps.description: Design custom rounded visual background configurations for cards, dynamic inputs, and primary control elements.

steps.title: Fix and Design Interactive Activity Layouts
steps.description: Validate and generate XML layouts for Login, Dashboard, Record Form, and Details views with valid dimensions.

steps.title: Develop Native Data Models
steps.description: Customer entity representing installation attributes with built-in JSON conversion adapters.

steps.title: Implement Cloud Network Client
steps.description: BackendApi client communicating with worker backend endpoints using HttpURLConnection and asset configuration.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Activity
steps.description: LoginActivity executing register and login operations with secure session token persistence.

steps.title: Implement Database Listing Screen
steps.description: MainActivity displaying installation cards, summary calculations, and real-time textual search.

steps.title: Implement Form Creator and Calculation Validation
steps.description: AddEditCustomerActivity with local balance calculation and optional logic verification check.

steps.title: Implement Details and Operations View
steps.description: CustomerDetailsActivity providing telephone intent and remote record deletion.

steps.title: Building CCTV Record Book
steps.description: Trigger final Gradle compilation to build and generate the debug Android application package.
